decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed development is considered to be unacceptable in the interests of visual amenity. More particularly, the proposed additional floor by virtue of its bulk to the rear and visibility from Ivor Road would represent an over dominant visual element which would be detrimental to the scale of property and out of keeping with the appearance of the property and the existing pattern of the development in the terrace. If permitted the development would harm the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, which the Council considers desirable to preserve and enhance in compliance with Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990. In this respect the proposed development would be contrary to Policies EN1 General environmental protection, EN14 Setting of new development, EN22 Extensions to existing buildings, EN24 Roof alterations and extensions, EN31 Character and appearance of ceonservation areas of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and 2.8 Roofs and terraces of the London Borough of Camden Special Planning Guidance 2002.
Reason : 2 - The proposed development is considered to be unacceptable in the interests of visual amenity. More particularly, the proposed front lightwell with railings around and stairs to the basement would represent a discordant visual element which would be out of keeping with the appearance of the property and the existing pattern of the development in the terrace generally, which has not been significantly impaired by railings and lightwells to the front. In this respect the proposed development would be contrary to policies EN1 General environmental protection and improvement, EN27 Basement Areas, EN31 Character and Appearance of Conservation Areas of the Unitary Development Plan. Furthermore, if permitted the development would harm the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, which the Council considers desirable to preserve and enhance in compliance with Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.


Reason : 3 - The proposed development is unacceptable, as it would result in the formation of one additional residential unit without making adequate provision for off-street car parking for a property fronting a street with limited parking. As a result the development would generate additional demand for on-street car parking and result in additional traffic movements, in an area that already experiences a high level of parking stress and a high level of traffic flows and congestion. In this regard the proposal is contrary to Policies TR16 Car free housing development and TR17 Residential parking standards and Standard DS8 Car parking of the Unitary Development Plan 2000.
Reason : 4 - The proposal is considered unacceptable on the grounds of residential amenity in that in the absence of sufficient details, the proposed ducting located within the proposed residential unit is considered harmful to internal living conditions. In this regard the application is contrary to Policies EN5 Noise and Vibration and EN6 Disturbance from plant and machinery and Standard DS6 Noise and Vibration of the Unitary Development Plan 2002.
ward: Camden Town with Primrose Hill (Pre May 2022)
description: Erection of an additional floor to form additional self-contained flat, formation of light well with railings around and stairs at front to give access to basement and extension of existing extract duct on rear elevation to terminate above new roof level.
